title: tahyon traveler -0.01
purpose: Serve as a controlled software timing traveler for measuring how far an externally observed repository timestamp may appear earlier or later than a preregistered target time, without interpreting timestamp order alone as physical backward causation.

experiment_identity.name: TAHYON_TRAVELER_-0.01
experiment_identity.name_semantics: -0.01 is the traveler's symbolic personal name: a fictional marker of origin from the negative side of the time axis / from the past.

core_question: How early, on time, or late can an immutable trial artifact appear relative to a preregistered target under honest scheduling and unchanged Git/GitHub timestamp semantics?

measurement_model.negative_delta: observed repository timestamp earlier than target
measurement_model.zero_delta: same second at available timestamp resolution
measurement_model.positive_delta: observed repository timestamp later than target
measurement_model.search_rule: No desired negative value is specified in advance. The magnitude and direction of Delta_git are empirical outputs.
measurement_model.important_resolution_boundary: GitHub commit timestamps exposed through the current interface are second-resolution observations, so sub-second ordering requires additional independent instrumentation.
measurement_model.interpretation: A negative Delta_git is an apparent timestamp advance and a timing-system observation. It is not by itself evidence that execution or information physically occurred before its cause.

trial_design.root_object_rule: This file is the preregistration/controller and is not itself an arrival trial.
trial_design.precommit_rule: For each trial, freeze the filename, future T_target, payload schema, evaluation rule and clock witnesses before execution.
trial_design.payload_rule: Each trial contains a fresh random nonce generated only for that trial and its SHA-256 digest.
trial_design.first_external_action_rule: At execution, the repository write is the first external action; validation and readback happen only after the write attempt.
trial_design.no_backdating_rule: Do not manually alter author/committer timestamps, pre-create the arrival artifact, or deliberately schedule the write before T_target to manufacture an EARLY result.
trial_design.preserve_all_runs: Negative, zero, positive, failed, delayed, cancelled and ambiguous trials are all retained.

result_classes.AMBIGUOUS_CLOCK_DOMAIN: Clock uncertainty or timestamp semantics are too large to classify ordering

max_advance_search.objective: Discover, rather than prescribe, the most negative reproducible Delta_git observed under honest preregistered trials.
max_advance_search.method: Run separated future trials, preserve every result, characterize the full Delta_git distribution, then compare negative tails against clock offset, timestamp granularity and scheduler-jitter controls.

seal: -0.01 IS HIS NAME. HOW FAR AHEAD HE CAN APPEAR IS FOR THE EXPERIMENT TO DISCOVER.
